lists.content:
• Regional Tax Compliance: Work closely with the Tax & Accounting team to support and ensure the timely submission of tax returns and compliance obligations across Mexico, Brazil, and other Americas jurisdictions.
  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Review monthly and quarterly financial data, assisting in variance analysis regarding sales, margins, inventories, and operational data across the region to support Management decision-making.
  • Systems & Data Integration: Actively support data-improvement projects and the development of our ERP system (MS Dynamics 365), acting as an interface function between accounting data and our e-commerce platform data.
  • Cross-Border Support: Participate in projects aimed at increasing tax compliance and aligning local accounting processes with global standards (IFRS).
  • Audit & Documentation Support: Assist in gathering, organizing, and reviewing tax certificates and accounting support required for internal audits, external audit firms, or cross-border transactions.

opening:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?
 
We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we’ve become the world’s largest D2C sleep brand, available in over 20 countries with more than 35 stores across Europe. Recommended by leading consumer associations in EMEA, APAC, and the Americas, we develop the best sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. 
 
  
At Emma, we are a community of smart, driven people, united by a strong culture of collaboration, teamwork, and knowledge sharing. We think big, take ownership, and are empowered to drive meaningful impact. Through hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning, we drive our own growth and learning. With Emmies from over 70 nationalities and offices across multiple regions, our diverse perspectives enrich our workplace culture. Ready to shape the future of sleep with us? Let’s make it happen!

description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.

lists.content:
• Assist in motivating and managing the Sleep Experts (sales staff) to meet and exceed sales targets. 
• Advise customers on products to help them achieve the ultimate night's sleep, enhancing the customer experience. 
• Oversee administrative tasks, stock management, and shift coordination, ensuring the sales floor is always optimized for conversion. 
• Execute all visual merchandising guidelines to the highest standards, maintaining consistent in-store presentation. 
• Take ownership of the store when required, confidently managing operations in the absence of the Store Manager with a strong business mindset.

opening:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us?
